content: Ikonium Aom Winiwen

Kwane, Ikonium yaa kwangkon Pool yoom Baanabas yoom kuu yi koobdande Yuudan yi kurikuri ambiwoom winiwen. Wenekorib, kuyaombed weng manimanandeb karadkonomo dakmiiwa, Yuudaniib Yuudanbaniib nimakarub yemoonbed mene anam andiwen.
Kumban Yuudan kane kane anam andindodan kumbed Yuudanban yena kuu ben yi inamen arewa yaa yondiiwe, Pool awene yaa dowakeniibban keriwen.

Kwane, Pool yoom Baanabas yoom kumbed aron doboob doberenib Yariman ye mimyob dowaken kabamoon konoon ye weng kuu arudkonoyiibbed dakmenabiwen. Kwane, Yariman yaromkono yi yaa kondoone, dud korokbiyiib yeka mamaa ye wedme binangki yemaniib ongmenabiwen. Kwamune keroon kuu ye weng kuu anam anam korokbi yeman.
Kumban nimakarub korem siti kumaom kuu andokbiwen, yena kuu Yuudan ye kerekmen angka winiiwe, yena kuu apasodan yi kerekmen angka keriiwe kamiwen.
Kwane, Yuudanban yenayiib Yuudan yenayiib yi korok korok yoom kumbed apasodan kuu arewa kamende botbed yenbandande kamiwen.
Kumban yikaadkerekoriwa, kirokmone wene Laikoniadan yi siti Laistara yoom Deebe yoom bidambib aom winiwen.
Kwane kuyaa kuu God ye weng amun kuu dakmenabiwen.
Laistara Yoom Deebe Yoom Aom Winiwen
Laistara aom kuu karub maa wooneen yaron yaambed yon yidnoon kowe, ma dodkanmo yarimokban.
Ye kuu Poolbed ku dakmeen kuyaamo wengaan. Kwane, Poolbed wedmenoonka, ye anam andi yaambed Godbed ye ongmaneen kuu yimin kowe,
baande yedmoon, “Eb dembe yaro dore!” andoon. Kwanandoona, kuyaambed karub kuu korongbere yaro dodkanmo yaroon.
Kwane, nimakarub yemoon kuu Poolbed kwanoon kuu wedmekoriwa, yi weng Laikonia wengbed baande dakmiwen, “God yena kuu karub nub areb kerenib, nuwiib yaa ke meniib kei!” andiwen.
Kwane, yimbed Baanabas ye aningko kuu Gurikdan yi god yi korok Seus andiib, Pool ye aningko kuu Gurikdan yi god maa Heemes andiwen, amborom kuu ye kuu dakmi ye korok kowe.

Kwane, Seus ye kurikuri boyambib darewoob taun bunangka angkeen ye kurikuri korokbed buromakau ambiyiib at wuung nong wuungiib kuu taun kuuk ambongko yaa be monoon, amborom kuu ye yoom kadaareb yoom yi dowaken kuu nengke baeb amun kondekorib Pool yoom Baanabas yoom yaa kurikuri kamandamiib kowe.
Kumban apasodan ayoob Pool yoom Baanabas yoom kuu weng kee wengamberekoriwa, miin kubiyiibban kere yi ebkad biringkenenib kirodmo wene nimakarub kuu nedbiwen kidangka awune komkiwen,

“Yiib komande kwane kamiib? Nub kangkon karub, yiib areb nub mimo kei! Nub kuu God ye weng amun kanmenuub kii! Kee kwane dakmubko yiib minikmanak arewa yaa kuu korondekorib, Wad Doreen ye God yaa amonombime. Yembed ambidiib okadiib karamokiib kumkam koremiib kuu ongmenaboon kui.
Kurin anuk kuu nimakarub korem kuu Godbed domondoona yika yi kiwaan onme dobiriwen.

Kumban ye kuu miin korem domondoona yiibka dobirindo. Yembed yiib yaa amun kerundene mongkobon animaniib amiib kondimaan. Kwane, animan yemoonbed kondene kwane yiib niindem aom kubiyiib kondimaan. Kukuu God doreen yiib akmi yeman kui.” andiwen.
Weng kee kwamune dakmiwen kumban, kadaareb yi dowaken darewoob kuu dingkan nengke baeb amun kondenib kurikuri kamandamiiwe, yedme yedme kamiibkob korondiwen.

Kwane, kuyaambed Yuudan yena Antiok yaayiib Ikonium yaayiib miniwen kumbed kadaareb kuu ben yi kerekmen yaa yondekorib, Pool kuu botbed barambere ayiwen. Kwane, yimbed meeniib kuu bobnoon ande awine irinde kanwene taun bunangka korariwen.
Kumban anam andiwendanbed menekoriwa nedbe kanawane duruniiwa, ye ika yaro dore taun aom wonoon. Kuye awarimbed Pool yoom Baanabas yoom Deebe yaa winiwen.
Ika Antiok Taun Siria Aom Winiwen
Deebe taun kuyaom kuu yimbed weng amun dakmiiwa nimakarub yemoon menenib anam andenib yi yaa dabokniwen. Kwane, yi kuyaambed domonde wene Laistara dore Ikonium dore Antiok yaa ika winiwen.

Ika winiwen ye dowad kuu anam andiwendan taun keyaom doriib yaa ambobandenib anam andi kuu kwane awine dobirime ande ongkandiwen, “Yobdood yemoon kuu burudandekoruwed, Godbed korok kere oonimbon aom kuu aomnanuub.” andiwen.

Kwane, anam andiwendan ku nedbiwen korem kumaom kuu Pool yoom Baanabas yoombed karub mimim biiwe, yi ooni korok korok keriwen. Kwane, animan koronde kamenib kurikuri kamenib anam andiwendan kuyi Yariman ye dingki ari nongkobiwen.
Kwane, yi kuu kuyaa domonde Pisidia ambibkin yaadin wene kumbed dore Pamfilia ambibkin aom winiwen.
Kwane, yi kuu Peega taun aom weng amun dakmekoriwa kumbed Atalia taun yiri winiwen.

Atalia yaambed parai motodbed ika Antiok yaa yaniwen. Kuyaa kumbed anuk kuu yenambed Godbed oonok ande kurikuri kamiwendan yaa ika miniwen. God ye mimyob dowaken kabamoon kondoon yaambed God ye deme awine winiwen, kumbed kwane ika miniwen kuu yi deme dowan keriwen kowe.
Kuu mene nandiwen yaron ari kuu anam andiwendan yaa baandiiwe nedbiiwe, Godbed yi yaambed komo kamooniib Yuudanban yi dowad anam andi ye ambongko nandooniib korem kuu dakmiwen.
Kwane kuyaa kuu anam andiwendan yoom aron doboob dobiriwen.
